title: Explore the dataset from three-dimensional nanostructure of an intact microglia cell
author: Tom TB Boissonnet
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u4eeyte

steps.title: Install Fiji, Blender, and NeuroMorph addon
steps.instruction: Download and install Fiji from https://fiji.sc/, download and install Blender, and download the NeuroMorph_3D_Drawing.py addon (part of the NeuroMorph project) from https://github.com/NeuroMorph-EPFL/NeuroMorph.

steps.title: Add NeuroMorph addon in Blender
steps.instruction: In Blender open File → User Preferences, select the Add‑ons tab, click “Install from File”, locate NeuroMorph_3D_Drawing.py, enable it, and click “Save User Settings”. Ensure the search bar is empty if the file is not found.

steps.title: Generate full‑resolution 3D stacks in Fiji
steps.instruction: Open Fiji, load the two EM stacks Dataset1.tif and Dataset2.tif, then run Plugins → Macro → Run and choose Generate_3D_image_stacks.ijm (included in the dataset). Confirm the prompt to generate ~20 GB of images per axis, select a folder for the three stacks, and wait about 15 minutes for the macro to finish.

steps.title: Open Segmented.blend file in Blender
steps.instruction: In Blender choose File → Open, locate the Segmented.blend file (provided with the dataset), and open it. Use the wheel to zoom, wheel‑click‑drag to pan, Ctrl + wheel to move left/right, Shift + wheel to move up/down, and Shift + F for Fly mode (WASD or arrow keys to fly, mouse wheel to adjust speed, left click to exit, right click to reset view).

steps.title: Downscale EM stacks and create reduced 3D stacks
steps.instruction: Open Fiji again, load Dataset1.tif and Dataset2.tif. For each dataset select Image → Scale, set X, Y and Z scale to 0.5 with all checkboxes checked, then close the original file. Rename the down‑scaled files back to Dataset1.tif and Dataset2.tif. Run Plugins → Macro → Run → Generate_3D_image_stacks.ijm, confirm to generate ~2.5 GB of data (the script mentions 20 GB for full resolution), and wait about 5 minutes for completion.

steps.title: Load EM stacks into Blender via Neuromorph
steps.instruction: In Blender, select the Neuromorph tab on the left panel, go to the 3D Drawing section, and set dimensions x = 31.72, y = 23.80, z = 22.60 (independent of image resolution). Set the source X, Y, Z folders to the location of the generated stacks. In the right‑hand object list, choose ImageStackLadder, press Tab while the mouse is in the object view panel, click a point on the ImageStackLadder object, then in the left 3D Drawing panel press “Show Image(s) at Vertex”. You can now click‑and‑drag the EM images.

steps.title: Adjust object visibility and add transparency
steps.instruction: In the object list panel click the eye icon to hide or show objects. To add transparency, select the desired object, go to the Neuromorph tab → 3D Drawing, click “Add Transparency”, and choose the alpha (transparency intensity) and object colour.
